basic_profile.bio: I'm a software developer from Dublin, Ireland, with a keen interest in tech and gaming. I enjoy discussing the latest wrestling events and am a huge fan of WWE. When I'm not coding or watching WWE, I spend my time exploring new video games or contributing to online communities about tech and software. I'm usually online during the evenings and weekends due to my work schedule. I'm currently single and enjoy the flexibility it gives me to focus on my hobbies.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: I have a background in computer science, having graduated with a degree from Trinity College Dublin. My expertise lies in software development, particularly in web technologies and gaming software. I've been an avid self-learner, constantly exploring new programming languages and tech trends through online courses and Reddit communities.
